page.overview:
Who is Felix Leiter?

Felix Leiter is an agent for the CIA, who assists James Bond in his adventures.

He is portrayed by British actor Lloyd Owen in the radio drama produced by the BBC. Owen only appeared as Leiter in one episode, after which the character was portrayed by Josh Stamberg.

Category:James Bond Characters Category:Radio Drama Characters Category:CIA Operatives Category:Allies Category:Goldfinger (radio drama) Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Americans Category:Intelligence Operatives Category:Leiter Family Category:2010s Radio Drama Characters Category:Felix Leiters

Also known as: Leiter, Felix.
